An '''individual''' acquired the formula for [[Slipthroat Grizmallt Liquor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They undertook a dangerous journey to deliver the formula, during which all their companions were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Hyper-Dangerous Mission|}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The individual encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who agreed to escort them to their destination. They encountered hostile forces on the way but survived. After doing so, the individual revealed that they were carrying the formula for Slipthroat Grizmallt Liquor.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The individual appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its shutdown in [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The mission involving the individual could randomly appear across different in-game [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="SWG" />
